synthesis.headline: Management exhibits mixed reliability, lowering revenue guidance while maintaining operating margin commitments and expanding historical profits.

points.text: Management continuously lowered FY27 revenue growth guidance from 1.5-3.5% down to 1.0-2.0%, while dropping effective tax rate and Financial Services growth targets entirely.
Operating margin targets for FY27 (20.0-22.0%) remain on track at an actual 21.03% EBIT margin so far, supported by stable recent quarterly margins.
Multiple operational targets, including Q3FY26 AI revenue contribution and hiring commitments for college grads and Frontier Engineers, remain unverifiable due to missing reporting.
Long-term financials demonstrate strong operational expansion, with annual revenues reaching ₹178,650 crore and PAT growing to ₹29,474 crore in Mar 2026.

bull.text: FY27 operating margin guidance of 20.0-22.0% is on track with 21.03% EBIT margin achieved through 2 quarters.
Strong financial position marked by 40.0% ROCE, low debt-to-equity of 0.09, and Mar 2026 CFO of ₹33,986 crore.
Consistent annual top-line and net profit expansion, with Mar 2026 PAT climbing to ₹29,474 crore.

bear.text: Management repeatedly reduced FY27 revenue growth guidance from 1.5-3.5% down to 1.0-2.0% by Oct 2026.
Key promises regarding effective tax rates and segment growth directions were quietly dropped from recent earnings calls.
Working capital efficiency worsened, with debtor days and cash conversion cycle both rising from 63 to 72 days.
